title: These do not turn!
text: These do not turn!. If these actually turned the way they're supposed to, I'm sure they'd be great, but they DO NOT!  I'm beyond frustrated, but will keep trying to find a better set that actually does what it says it will do.

product_metadata.title: Segbeauty Matte Black Shampoo Dispenser, 2pcs 16.9oz Empty Refillable Pump Bottle with Labels, 500ml Plastic Press Lotion Dispenser Bathroom Shower Containers for Conditioner Body Soap Hand Soap
features: 【Large Capacity with 6 Water-proof Self-Labeling Stickers】Each dispenser bottle holds 16.9oz/500ml large capacity to meet the whole family essential need. 6 separate water-proof label stickers BODY SOAP, SHAMPOO, CONDITIONER, HAND SOAP, DISH SOAP, LOTION are NOT pre-stuck on the bottles, you can stick them for your free choice.

【Durable & Eco-Friendly】 Set of 2 matte black soap dispenser are made of thickened BPA free plastic and PP pump head. That will not rust and dispense smoothly, don't worry about breakage. The black bottles can prevent the liquid from going bad even under the sun. Safe enough to fill with a variety of room-temperature daily use liquids.
【Portable & Leak-Proof】 It is very suitable for travel and easy to carry, press down and twist clockwise to close, preventing the lotion from leaking. Twist anti-clockwise to open and use.
【Easy to Refill and Use】Just remove the pump head and refill lotion with the wide mouth. Gently press the pump head to dispense it.

【Multipurpose Design】Designed with modern style look, our soap dispenser could perfectly match kitchen and bathroom. Ideal for dish soap, hand soap, lotion, body wash, liquid soap, shower gel, shampoo and conditioner ect.
